distance.cleared: Location cleared after the retention period

visits.title: Site visits
visits.description: Check-ins and check-outs at the customer's site, with how far from the saved site location they were.
visits.empty: No one has checked in at this site yet.
visits.caption: Site visits on this project
visits.farCount: {count, plural, one {# far from the site} other {# far from the site}}

geotag.label: Where taken
geotag.noSite: Location recorded, site location not saved, {time}
geotag.cleared: Taken at {time}, location cleared after the retention period

claims.title: Travel claims
claims.description: Travel between site visits. The system makes the claim when a worker ends duty, at the rate in Settings. Approving makes a payable to the employee in Finance.
claims.caption: Travel claims
claims.emptyBody: Claims show here when workers end duty.
claims.waiting: {count, plural, one {# claim waiting for approval} other {# claims waiting for approval}}
claims.amountChanged: The amount changed to {amount} after new route points. Check and decide again.
claims.approvedBody: Finance can pay it from Payables.
claims.approveNote: Approving adds a payable of {amount} to the employee in Finance, and books it as travel cost.

void.title: Void this approved claim?
void.description: {amount} is cancelled in Finance and its ledger entry is reversed (the entry stays, a reversing one is added). It cannot be voided once paid. The person is told and can claim the day again.
void.reasonHint: For example: claimed for the wrong day. The person sees this.

sheet.title: Travel on {day}
sheet.legsHint: Straight-line distance between stops, not road distance.
sheet.unpaidLeg: No location at one end, not paid
sheet.noProject: Not tied to a project, so it is not in any project's cost.
sheet.noVisits: No site check-ins on this day.
sheet.ownClaim: Someone else approves your own claim.
sheet.legsHintRoute: Straight-line distance between stops. The paid km come from the recorded route.
sheet.capNote: The route was longer than the allowed share of the straight line, so the paid km were cut to {paid}.
sheet.gapNote: {count, plural, one {# stretch} other {# stretches}} with no location, {minutes} min in all, counted as a straight line.
sheet.autoMade: Made automatically from the route when the day ended.

settings.title: Site check-ins and travel
settings.description: How far from the saved site a check-in can be before it is flagged, when location may be read, and what travel between sites is paid.
settings.farFromSiteHint: A check-in farther than this from the saved site is flagged to the project manager, never refused.
settings.pinTrustHint: A roof pin farther than this from where the worker checked in is saved, and flagged for the office to check.
settings.rateHint: Paid per km of the day’s route, or of the straight line between stops when no route was recorded.
settings.marginHint: Location is read only from the day’s start minus this to its end plus this.
settings.autoClaimOn: When the day ends, the system makes the travel claim for the person.
settings.autoClaimOff: People make their own claim from the field app.
settings.autoApproveHint: Turn on to approve clean days automatically each morning.
settings.autoApproveOn: A day with a recorded route, no gaps, no fake GPS and no far check-ins is approved the next morning and goes to Finance.
settings.autoApproveOff: Every claim waits for a manager.
settings.routeCapHint: Paid km never go above the straight-line distance between stops times this. Under 1 km of straight line, at most 2 km is paid and a manager checks it.
settings.maxKmHint: A day with more paid km than this always waits for a manager.
settings.maxAmountHint: A claim worth more than this always waits for a manager.

review.route_gap: The phone sent no location for a long stretch.
review.fake_gps: A fake or mock location was reported.
review.cap_applied: The route was far longer than the straight line, so it was cut.
review.far_check_in: A site check-in was far from the site.
review.visit_no_location: A site visit has no location.
review.auto_closed: The day was ended by the system, not by the person.
review.delayed_tap: A check-in or check-out reached the server late.
review.over_km: More km than the automatic limit.
review.over_amount: More money than the automatic limit.
review.no_route: No route was recorded, so this is a straight-line distance.
review.no_visits: There was no site visit that day.
review.uncapped_route: The day was under 1 km in a straight line, so the route was not held to the usual cap.
review.short_route: The recorded route was shorter than the straight line, so the straight line is paid.
review.start_outside_office: The day was started away from an office.
review.end_outside_office: The day was ended away from an office.
review.on_leave: The person was on leave this day.
review.other: Needs a person to look at it.
